verdict.rationale: Typesense has no dedicated sandbox mode. Isolated test environments come from spinning up separate instances: it can run locally or on any server via Docker and other packages. The docs also include guides for running tests with Testcontainers and in GitHub Actions, which lets users test against throwaway instances instead of production data. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox or test-mode environment (e.g. in Typesense Cloud), documented ways to clone or seed production-like data safely, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the testing workflows beyond section headings.
